title: Impacts Of The Climate Change
definition: Climate change refers to long-term shifts in temperatures and weather patterns, primarily driven by anthropogenic greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions, resulting in systemic disruptions to the Earth's biosphere, cryosphere, and socio-economic stability.
importanceInUpsc: This is a core theme in GS Paper III (Environment & Ecology) and GS Paper I (Geography). It is frequently linked to disaster management, food security, and international relations (COP summits).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Impacts Of The Climate Change.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
